instruction: Make a copy of the receipt image OIP.jpg from /home/user and save it to the Pictures folder with the same filename.

metadata.explanation: Task requires copying the receipt image file to the Pictures folder. The custom getter checks if the image file exists at /home/user/Pictures/OIP.jpg and verifies it's a valid image by checking magic bytes for common image formats (JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF). The metric compares the existence result against the expected value (should_exist=true).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly checks if file exists at target location /home/user/Pictures/OIP.jpg
Getter validates file is a valid image by checking magic bytes (JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF)
Metric correctly compares boolean result against expected.should_exist value
Data flow is correct: getter returns bool, metric receives rules dict directly (via get_rule)
Minor incompleteness: evaluator only verifies copy exists, does not verify original file still exists (to confirm copy vs move operation)
For practical purposes, checking destination file exists and is valid image is sufficient to verify copy task completion
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding verification that original file /home/user/OIP.jpg still exists to confirm it was copied (not moved)
Consider adding file size/content comparison between original and copy to ensure they are identical
